INCIDENT TYPE:
CROSS-SITE SCRIPTING (XSS)

DESCRIPTION:
Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) is a web application vulnerability that allows attackers to inject malicious JavaScript into web pages viewed by other users. Successful exploitation can lead to session hijacking, credential theft, website defacement, and unauthorized actions performed on behalf of victims.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1059.007 | JavaScript

INDICATORS:
- Unexpected JavaScript execution
- Suspicious pop-ups
- Unauthorized redirects
- Session hijacking activity
- Modified web page content
- Stolen session cookies

DETECTION RULES:
- Suspicious script injection
- Unexpected JavaScript execution
- Unauthorized DOM modifications

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Web applications
- User browsers
- Customer portals
title: CROSS-SITE SCRIPTING (XSS)
